info.title: AgentMeter API — cloud preparation
info.description: Prepares an uploaded file or a link into a set of flows while the GPU is busy, with the same code as the GPU backend (identical flows and hash).

post.summary: Prepare one input (a signed job from the control plane)

401.description: Not logged in / bad or missing token or signature

post.description: Reads the input from a single-use URL, runs the server's own preparation code (identical flows and hash), uploads the files to single-use URLs and reports progress, signed.

userToken.description: Access token from POST /api/auth/login on the control plane (15 minutes). Scope admin: the user's role must be admin.

runToken.description: Run token from POST /api/runs/authorize on the control plane (5 minutes; single use for actions); its scope is the token's kind. Not needed in one-user mode (no control plane).

backendSignature.name: X-AM-Signature
backendSignature.description:
hex HMAC-SHA256(BACKEND_SECRET, method
path
X-AM-Timestamp
sha256(body)); X-AM-Timestamp (unix seconds) within 120 s.

prepSignature.name: X-AM-Signature
prepSignature.description: The same signature with CLOUD_PREP_SECRET (preparation service → control plane).

controlPlaneSignature.name: X-AM-Signature
controlPlaneSignature.description: The same signature with CLOUD_PREP_SECRET (control plane → preparation service).
